page.metaDescription: Fullstack CV. Node.js, TypeScript, React, APIs, data modeling, PostgreSQL/MySQL/MongoDB/Redis, Tailwind CSS, responsive UI, dashboards.
page.titleTagline: Fullstack · Node.js · TypeScript · React · Architecture · Data Systems
page.summary: Software engineer with 20+ years of programming experience and 10+ years of production Node.js development. Designed and implemented backend systems using Node.js and TypeScript, with strong emphasis on modular architecture, data modeling and scalable service design. Experienced in building fullstack applications including React-based frontend (dashboards, internal tools) with modern CSS approaches such as Tailwind. Strong focus on maintainability, performance and clean system design. Comfortable taking ownership of technical decisions and building systems end-to-end.
